about: Oro-Medonte is a township in Simcoe County, Ontario, between Barrie and Orillia on the northwest shore of Lake Simcoe and toward the Oro Moraine. Villages and shoreline communities such as Hawkestone, Shanty Bay, and Horseshoe Valley sit among farms, ski hills, and forest—not a continuous city. About 23,000 people live in Oro-Medonte.
seoSummary: Simcoe County township of Lake Simcoe shores and Horseshoe Valley—villages and countryside, not a city.
